title: Why the Moon Pulls You Toward It

segments.text: The Moon pulls harder on your side than the far side.
The near side feels stronger gravity, the far side weaker.
Ocean water slides away from the crust toward the Moon.
The Sun pulls more overall, but the Moon is closer, so its gradient is steeper.
That steeper gradient stretches you more.
The Moon’s pull is what shapes tides.
The Moon pulls harder on you.
